read.thesis: Delta's June quarter beat on revenue (adjusted TRASM +12.4% on ~1% capacity growth) but adjusted operating margin fell to 8.8% from 13.3% on a 75% jump in fuel price; September guide is 11–13% margin.

triggers.label: Adjusted TRASM +12.4% YoY
triggers.quote: Adjusted total unit revenue (TRASM) grew 12.4 percent over prior year.

triggers.label: Capacity growth ~1%, modest
triggers.quote: June quarter total revenue increased 14 percent over the same period last year to a record $17.7 billion on approximately 1 percent capacity growth.

triggers.label: 3Q operating margin 11–13%
triggers.quote: In the September quarter, we expect earnings per share to grow over prior year to $2.00 to $2.50 on an operating margin of 11 to 13 percent

triggers.label: Fuel price +75% YoY
triggers.quote: Adjusted fuel price of $3.93 per gallon increased 75 percent year-over-year

guidance.quote: Affirming full-year guidance for adjusted EPS of $6.50 to $7.50 and free cash flow of $3 to $4 billion
Affirming full-year guidance for adjusted EPS of $6.50 to $7.50 and free cash flow of $3 to $4 billion
For the September quarter, we expect revenue to grow mid-teens over prior year on modest capacity growth
In the September quarter, we expect earnings per share to grow over prior year to $2.00 to $2.50 on an operating margin of 11 to 13 percent
we expect to reach gross leverage of approximately 2x by year-end

red_flags.label: Free cash flow down 71% YoY to $209M
Non-fuel CASM up 6.8%
